{{Quote|There are so many. There's a slave&mdash;a Bothan, Trask&mdash;he shattered his ankle. Compound fracture, and it's septic. I'll have to take off his foot. And that'll probably kill him anyway.|Jacen Solo, speaking about Trask|<ref name="Traitor" />}}
'''Trask''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="Traitor" /> which began in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TERC2">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> He was captured by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], an extra-galactic [[Species/Legends|species]] that invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] to work on a [[Unidentified seedship|Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Sh'rip Sh'pa|seedship]], which was a kind of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].<ref name="Traitor" /> In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> Trask suffered a compound ankle fracture that went septic. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], who was also enslaved by the Yuuzhan Vong, was forced to [[Dismemberment/Legends|amputate]] the Bothan's foot with an [[amphistaff]], an organic Yuuzhan Vong weapon. Trask went into delirium and [[Death/Legends|died]] five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later.<ref name="Traitor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trask appeared in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]'', a novel in the [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] series. ''Traitor'' was written by [[Matthew Stover]] and published in [[July]] [[2002]].
